# LumaRAW v0.4.1 — English source release

First public source release of LumaRAW, a native macOS RAW darkroom with non-destructive editing and a shared CLI/MCP interface for agents.

Version 0.4.1 adds version-tagged source publication through a checked GitHub Actions workflow. App, engine, MCP, and TIFF software metadata report version 0.4.1.

## Highlights

- Native SwiftUI library, inspector, editing tools, export queue, and settings, with English UI and documentation.
- Nikon NEF/NRW development through LibRaw, with original files kept unchanged.
- Metal-accelerated grading and output color conversion, with a portable CPU reference and fallback. RAW parsing, decompression, and demosaicing remain on CPU.
- Tone curves, color mixer, local masks, denoise/sharpen, manual lens correction, camera-bound chart profiles, LUTs, and ICC soft proofing.
- JPEG and 16-bit TIFF export with embedded sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, or ProPhoto RGB profiles.
- 27 MCP tools, a matching JSON CLI, and an English agent skill sharing catalog revision checks and durable export snapshots.
- MIT license for original code, preserved third-party notices, and checked source packaging that excludes private catalogs, RAW fixtures, logs, credentials, and generated binaries.

## Download and build

Download **LumaRAW-0.4.1-source.zip** and verify it against **SHA256SUMS.txt**. This release contains source; build the macOS app using the README. Prebuilt application binaries are not included.

The build targets Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer, using Xcode Command Line Tools and uv. Actual validation was performed on macOS 26. Dependencies are pinned in `uv.lock`.

```sh
uv sync --frozen
uv run --frozen python scripts/build_macos.py --build-root /absolute/new-build-directory
open /absolute/new-build-directory/LumaRAW.app
```

The build directory must not already exist. Local builds use ad-hoc signing; Developer ID signing and notarization are separate distribution steps.

## Validation

- Baseline validation: 100 Python tests passed with no skips, using a real D3S NEF and required Metal execution.
- 15 native state assertions passed.
- The official MCP client verified the 27-tool listing and completed Metal preview/export operations.
- The English app was built and its ad-hoc signature verified; gallery/develop, export, and settings were inspected on the desktop.
- Version 0.4.1 consistency checks passed for project metadata, engine status, MCP initialization, and exported TIFF metadata.
- The release ZIP matches the committed source snapshot and passes the public-source check. The 12 release-packaging tests also passed.

## Compatibility notes

Sync-group and preset names are now English. Clients of the earlier local builds should refresh `recipe_schema`; recipe fields and stored user data are unchanged.

Windows, Intel, older macOS, VoiceOver, complete keyboard traversal, and end-to-end monitor color management are not fully validated. Nikon NX Studio/Picture Control equivalence and universal HE/HE* support are not claimed. RAW decoding still requires full-frame memory; estimates and periodic RSS sampling are not an OS hard memory limit.

See README.md, TESTING.md, VERIFICATION.md, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the full scope.
